release_name: Live TV v5.2.2 (Build 57) — Polsat Sport Premium Super HD & UEFA Europa League
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ⚽ Added Polsat Sport Premium 2 Super HD: Official broadcast channel for UEFA Europa League & Champions League in full Super HD with dedicated sports stream failover
🏆 Added Polsat Sport Premium 1 Super HD: Flagship UEFA European tournaments channel with multi-server backup feeds
🛡️ Intelligent Multi-Server Failover: Instant fallback between high-definition sports feeds, beIN Sports Live, and European Sports broadcasts on 403 or network errors
🎾 Live Sports 'Watch Live' Instant Play: Seamless sports event tuning across macOS, Android, and Web without black screens
🔒 Secure HTTPS & Mixed Content Elimination: Verified CORS-enabled HTTPS feeds for all platforms
⇄ Last Channel Toggle & Recall: Alternates between current and previous channels with on-screen button labels and hotkey Q
👆 Player Controls Touch & Scroll Lock: Touching or scrolling through action pills and channels will never hide controls overlay
